orgDesign.domainName: Internet Number Registry and Routing Trust
orgDesign.companyProfile: Not-for-profit regional Internet registry and critical Internet infrastructure operator serving members, operators, researchers, policymakers, and the wider Internet community.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned groups own registry, member/governance, routing trust/DNS, and public measurement/data loops, with explicit coordination around security, policy impact, and public-service reliability.
designPrinciples: Keep registry stewardship close to member workflows.
Keep routing security and DNS authority under critical-infrastructure operating discipline.
Keep public data provenance and API stability explicit.
Keep policy implementation connected to affected product workflows.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups that mirror the product-brick domains.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
